title: Agent-judge for edges: built & operational; early prune ~30%; loop not yet run at scale
summary: The RAG-recall/agent-adjudicate edge system (task #5) is live. Substrate: lib/judge.js (pure, tested), daemon endpoints GET /judge/next?budget=N (cursor-advancing, epoch-aware, idles when drained) + POST /judge/verdict (createEdge judged:true,by:judge / keepEdge / pruneEdge / surfaceSupersede=guidance-only, no validTo). Blind autowireNoteProvider/sweepOrphanNotes DEMOTED — note-create now returns autowired:0 and enqueues instead of writing edges. Boot migration tagged ~273 blind note-provider edges judged:false (200 note→note + 73 note→task); live overlay now 263 queued / 7 agent-endorsed / 124 structural-untouched. New skill skills/self-learn-edge-judge (separate from the pre-existing attempt-merge self-learn-judge). Two-tick hand-played demo (budget 5) verdicts were genuinely reasoned: KEEP = note frames why a task exists / note IS the root cause / feature→sub-step; PRUNE = 'same topic different file, not a prerequisite' / 'topic-adjacent only' / dangling edge to a deleted note. Early prune ratio 3/10 (~30%) on the sample — confirms a real chunk of cosine edges was noise. Confirmed: pruned edges gone, supersede surfaced not applied, no-edge marks judged + epoch-gate re-pull works, cursor survives restart. Tests 26/26 suites green individually. CAVEATS (remaining work): (1) task→task context edges left unjudged — can't structurally distinguish blind autowireNewTask from hand-asserted suggest_links; (2) cursor is best-effort not exactly-once — GET /judge/next advances even with no verdict posted (observed), so judgedAtEpoch (orphans) + judged-flag (edges) are the real anti-re-judge guards, self-healing across laps not within one; (3) reasoning quality proven only on 10 hand-played items — the heartbeat loop is wired but NOT yet run end-to-end across all 263. Next validation = run the judge loop on the heartbeat (budget-limited) to get the TRUE prune ratio + confirm reasoning holds at scale.
